name: unsafe fn realloc (& self , ptr : * mut u8 , layout : Layout , new_size : usize) -> * mut u8
rule: If realloc returns a non-null pointer, the caller must not access the memory through the old ptr, even if the allocation remained in place; only the newly returned pointer may be used to access this memory.
api: trait GlobalAlloc  : { unsafe fn realloc (& self , ptr : * mut u8 , layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout , new_size : usize) -> * mut u8 }
